body:
My partner Ani and I built Pocket Dev because we wanted to spend less time tied to a desk without losing touch with our work.

Pocket Dev is free and open source. It brings your computer’s terminals, Claude Code and Codex chats, Git and files to your phone’s browser. Your work keeps running on your own computer, using your existing coding-agent accounts.

No phone app or Pocket Dev cloud account needed. Use the same Wi-Fi, or set up remote access for when you’re away. Your computer needs to stay on and awake.

Try it: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev
GitHub: https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anisirji/pocket-dev
Let your AI help you set it up: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts

If it makes your day a little freer, share it with three people you’d love to see escape the PC cage too. No pressure. ❤️

Video shows a demo project with scripted agent responses.

What would you want to check from your phone first?

#PocketDev #OpenSource #DeveloperTools
